project.title: Cua
project.summary: Script-speed computer use. A roadmap of the smallest existing surfaces that can carry the RFC, pinned to one commit.

artifacts.title: Architecture atlas
artifacts.headline: Existing owners. Fewer new layers.
artifacts.summary: Trace each requirement to the code that already owns it. This pass remapped the plan. It did not requalify acceptance or claim a measured speedup.
artifacts.decision: Prefer existing caller/helper/provider seams; hold new revision/composition semantics for their own decision and evidence.

steps.title: Finish measurement without another telemetry layer
steps.summary: Extend the existing runner event seam; preserve independent oracle-check time and cleanup-inclusive lifetime, residual, cold/warm and failure outcomes.
steps.gate: Existing timing work; no public Driver contract change intended.

steps.title: Reuse existing completion; test exact local rules
steps.summary: Preserve the already-implemented fixture done check. Add only a separately scoped, positive typed precondition fast path; reserved abstain/reobserve remains. No duplicate provider framework.
steps.gate: Model/general completion integration is a follow-up; do not re-expand the provider PR by assumption.

steps.title: Semantic-first lazy vision
steps.summary: Build semantic candidates before optionally capturing/parsing. Use visual fallback only when needed under an explicit caller policy; retain current eager path as baseline.
steps.gate: Caller behavior experiment; confirm scope with recipe owner. No new Driver API.

steps.title: Native verifier: skip unused producer work
steps.summary: At ToolObservationProvider.observe forward the existing accessibility-tree selector when include_elements=false; retain observation-only sampling. Resolve whether elapsed_ms is predicate time or total evidence time separately.
steps.gate: Internal projection if supported by all actual adapters; changing elapsed_ms promise may need separate contract decision.

steps.title: Compose existing budgets and native job lifetime
steps.summary: Distinguish setup deadline, per-node/provider deadline, verifier remaining budget and native worker lifetime. Extend existing owners only after adapter-specific evidence.
steps.gate: A hard public end-to-end timeout guarantee differs from current soft observation-loop semantics; decision required if promise changes.

steps.title: Native passive evidence and truthful action outcomes
steps.summary: Contribute to existing typed passive-observation/outcome work: observed content not executable token; skipped not no_change; topology advice not actuator proof.
steps.gate: Existing native public-contract RFC owners; do not infer approval from overlap or open status.

steps.title: Guarded caller runs, not a new Driver scheduler
steps.summary: After recorded decision, test a two-action caller run with fresh binding/preconditions for the second action. Keep browser recipe runs separate from desktop composites.
steps.gate: Explicit relaxation of existing one-frame/one-action recipe rule; no implementation/promotion presumed authorized.

steps.title: Shadow research at existing identity owners
steps.summary: Keep fresh observation. Attach read-only retention/churn measurements to browser/native snapshot owners; capture store stays distinct. No new authoritative revision registry.
steps.gate: New shadow ownership decision, not automatically included in snapshot cleanup approval.

steps.title: Conditional observation as its own proof-gated contract
steps.summary: Define requested-field invalidation separately for browser, AX, UIA, AT-SPI. Existing generation checks are prerequisites, not proof of all relevant unchanged state.
steps.gate: Separate public-contract approval plus useful shadow evidence; fresh-read fallback remains default.

steps.title: Reuse chooser contracts; keep calibration above Driver
steps.summary: Use existing bounded chooser and optional decision-model guard as prior art. Account for different response envelopes and candidate limits; do not wire incompatible outputs as drop-in.
steps.gate: Follow-up caller integration; planner handoff is optional, not a dependency for exact local rules.

steps.title: Cancellation and transport lifetime without replay
steps.summary: Coordinate cancellation at existing operation, resource permit and receiver owners. Transport close is not proof a native job stopped or a cloud claim was destroyed.
steps.gate: Respect each existing RFC scope; no second scheduler or generic reconnect mechanism.

steps.title: Extraction and release earned by independent use
steps.summary: Extract only duplicated semantics with two independent consumers. Regenerate canonical contracts and preserve original contributor authorship; keep optional dependencies optional.
steps.gate: Cross-component behavior requires recorded decision; two language ports of one fixture do not establish independent demand.
